headline: Congress honors 25th anniversary of 9/11 with solemn ceremonies; Senate resumes business Monday

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate met in pro forma session on Thursday, September 10, with minimal proceedings. The chamber adjourned briefly out of respect for the 25th anniversary of the September 11 terrorist attacks.

onTheFloor.title: Cloture vote on nomination to United States District Judge for the Southern District of Ohio
onTheFloor.status: cloture vote scheduled for approximately 5:30 p.m. Monday

house.lastSessionSummary: The House convened briefly on Thursday, September 10 and adjourned at 3:33 p.m. in observance of the 25th anniversary of the September 11 attacks. H. Res. 1520 expressing the sense of the House regarding the 2001 terrorist attacks was agreed to unanimously. The chamber adjudged as a mark of respect to the victims.
